title: Find the Largest Value
description: Return the largest number in the list, or None when the list is empty.

unhandled_short_input: There may be no candidate at the start.
Decide what an empty list should provide before comparing values.
A single value is already a complete search.
Trace empty, one-item, and two-item lists separately.
off_by_one: Every item needs a chance to be compared.
Trace which positions your search visits.
Check whether the final position is included.
Try the largest value at the beginning, middle, and end.
print_not_return: A displayed maximum is not the value the caller receives.
Check the function result after the search finishes.
The best candidate must leave the function as its result.
Test a one-item list and inspect the returned value.

explanations.empty_list: An empty list has no candidate maximum and should use the documented empty result.
explanations.short_input: A one-item list still has a well-defined largest value.
explanations.exact_boundary: Make sure the search includes the final candidate.
explanations.normal: Compare every candidate while keeping the largest seen so far.
